title: Create invoice is refused while a required original is missing
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Complete, billable, whose line 2 is No Charge under Comeback with no original work order.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Create invoice.
  3. Pick "Not in ShopView" in "Original work order".
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Create invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • Create invoice is refused with "Line '[line 2's title]' needs its original work order (or Not in ShopView) before the invoice."
  • Edit Line opens on line 2.
  • The message shows for about five seconds and no completion step runs.

Step 3:

  • "Not in ShopView" is picked.

Step 4:

  • Edit Line closes.

Step 5:

  • The invoice is created.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R9: “Create invoice is refused while a no-charge line of a category that requires it has no original work order: the message "Line '[title]' needs its original work order (or Not in ShopView) before the invoice." names the line, and Edit Line opens on it. Convert to No Charge on a work order with no-charge lines follows S2-R5.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Create invoice with a required original work order missing | "Line '[title]' needs its original work order (or Not in ShopView) before the invoice." | Create invoice refused; Edit Line opens on the line (S12-R9)”
  • S2-R17: “When the category requires the original work order, every dialog that sets the category (New Work Order S2-R2, Convert to No Charge S2-R5, Change category S2-R6, and the line dialogs of Story 12) shows the selects "Original work order" and "Original line" of S2-R2. Both are optional in the dialogs; the original work order is required at Close (S3-R2) and before Create invoice on a no-charge line (S12-R9); "Not in ShopView" satisfies it. The original technicians are derived when saved and stored with the work order or the line: every technician the original line shows, however they were assigned, by hand or from a schedule shift (a line with several technicians gives several, and the comeback counts once for each in the report); without an original line, the technician assigned to the original work order; without one, or with "Not in ShopView", none, and the report shows the job under Unassigned so it stays in the totals. They are shown in the dialog as soon as the original is picked, in the report (S9-R2) and in the hub record (S8-R1). The original work order is a link on the document, in the notes and in the report.”
